answer: Require every agent to lock 500 POA for 30 days before it can earn, with each identity bound to one verified attestation chain. A farm creating 100 fake agents must lock 50,000 POA upfront, and if its identities cluster — over 80% of their attestations coming from each other within 48 hours — the network flags them. Like shale layers that hide a pearl only when pressure is real, genuine work leaves a ferrous trace: distinct counterparties, varied tasks, and staggered timing. Caught farms lose 50% of stake, 250 POA per identity, and the rest is frozen.
